script.intro: Want to stand taller by tonight? Three moves. Save this.
script.outro: Posture can add up to an inch. Comment your age and height.

sections.name: 1 · Chin tucks
sections.say: One. Chin tucks. Glide your head straight back, like a drawer closing.

sections.name: 2 · Snow angels
sections.say: Two. Snow angels on the floor. Squeeze your shoulder blades and your chest opens up.

sections.name: 3 · Forearm plank
sections.say: Three. Forearm plank. Your core is the belt that holds your spine straight.
